historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission upheld, 7-0, the negative declaration for, and declined to intervene in the permits for, converting the four-storey-plus-basement building of about 41,500 square feet, one of three vacant buildings left from the Best Foods industrial plant, into live/work units with basement parking (Motion 14693).
